subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Breaking the crate on the west side of the room reveals two Silver Rupees after killing the Beamos with a bomb flower.

evidence.quote:
Now, on the west side of this room, kill the Beamos (with a bomb flower) and 
break the crate to get two Silver Rupees.

subject: Business Scrub
text: An elevator in Dodongo's Cavern leads to a Business Scrub who sells Deku Shields.

evidence.quote:
Ignore the elevator thing, 
it takes you to a Business Scrub who sells Deku Shields.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Collecting the last Silver Rupee by climbing the vine wall opens the door ahead.

evidence.quote:
The last one can be found 
by climbing the vine wall up here. Collecting that last one opens the door 
ahead.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Defeating all the Dodongos opens the door ahead and reveals a treasure chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Kill all the Dodongos (the bomb flower on the center pillar 
should help) to open the door ahead and reveal a treasure chest. Open it for 
the COMPASS.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Pulling three movable blocks under the suspended torches and lighting them with a Deku Stick opens up the room to the north.

evidence.quote:
There are three movable blocks here. What you must do is pull
them so that they are under the torches...Climb back up, light a Deku Stick using that torch, then
go down and light the other torches there. This opens up the room to the north.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Killing all the Gohma Larvae releases the lock and creates a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee or Deku Shield.

evidence.quote:
Killing them all
will release the lock out of here and create a treasure chest containing a Blue
Rupee/Deku Shield.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found inside one of the crates in the Gohma Larvae room.

evidence.quote:
Now, break all the crates in here until you find a Gold
Skulltula.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: A chest above the midair torch room contains a Blue Rupee or Deku Shield.

evidence.quote:
You're back in the midair torch room. Just head through back to the main room,
unless you want to grab the Blue Rupee/Deku Shield that's in the chest up here.

subject: Business Scrub
text: A Business Scrub behind a cracked wall offers a Red Potion for 40 Rupees after having a Deku Nut reflected back at him.

evidence.quote:
(If you want a Red Potion, blow open the 
cracked wall and enter the room revealed. Reflect a Deku Nut back and talk to 
the Business Scrub to get the opportunity for a Red Potion for 40 Rupees.)

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Triggering bomb flower chain reactions on both sides opens the way forward to a treasure chest containing the Bombs.

evidence.quote:
Pick
up a bomb flower there and place it beneath the bomb flowers there to create a
chain reaction and open the way forward. Enter, and open the treasure chest for
the BOMBS, finally.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Blowing up the wall of boulders in the top-right room of the second floor leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Head back to the room you first fought Lizalfos. In other words, the top-right
room of the 2nd floor. See the wall of boulders on one end? Hop over there and
blow them up with your new Bombs. Follow the path up there to find a Gold 
Skulltula.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Pulling the gravestone in the room past the Armos reveals a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Poe to unlock the way back out, and pull the gravestone to find a
treasure chest holding a Blue Rupee.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Song of Time near the blue blocks south of the staircase room makes them disappear, revealing a Gold Skulltula in a corner.

evidence.quote:
- South of the staircase room, on the lower floor, is a room filled with blue
 blocks. Make them disappear by playing the Song of Time near them. The Gold
 Skulltula is in a corner.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the room north of the Poe room, kill all enemies and retrieve the Gold Skulltula using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
- The room north of the Poe room. If it isn't open, use the bomb flower nearby
 and place it under the bomb flowers on the wall to open it. Inside, kill all
 the enemies then use the Boomerang to get the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Returning as Adult Link to the room with tombstones, fire, and Armos, climb to the top of the walls to kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
- In the room with tombstones, fire, and Armos, return as Adult Link. Climb 
 onto the top of the walls over where the Armos' are, and kill the Gold 
 Skulltula up there.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Bombing the boulder in the entrance area reveals a switch bump that spawns a treasure chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the boulder to make a
switch bump appear. Step on it to make a treasure chest appear. Open it for the
DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Shooting one of the cows stuck in the mouth with the Fairy Slingshot spawns a chest with Deku Nuts inside.

evidence.quote:
Now, see the cows stuck in the sides of the mouth? L-Target them
and shoot them with the Fairy Slingshot. One will spawn a chest with Deku Nuts
inside, the other will open the door ahead.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Shooting the cow stuck in the wall spawns a chest on the lower level that contains Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the cow stuck in the wall to make another
chest appear. Can't reach it from here, so take the floating platform down.
Open the chest for some Deku Nuts

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Shooting the cow submerged underwater makes a treasure chest appear in a hidden alcove containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the cow to make a treasure chest appear in a
hidden alcove. Swim down there towards the cow and surface. Open the chest for
the COMPASS.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Shooting the stuck cow in the room after dropping down the hole spawns a treasure chest containing Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Now look for 
another stuck cow. Shoot it to make a treasure chest appear containing Deku 
Nuts.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: A chest located in the trench contains Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Take down the Lizalfos in the hall, then open the
chest when you get to the trench for some more Deku Nuts.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Killing the Like Like and Stingers spawns a chest in an alcove containing the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Like Like 
and the Stingers to create a treasure chest in an alcove. Step on the switch
here to raise the water level, and climb up the vines to reach the chest. Open
it for the BOOMERANG.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Shooting the cows and defeating the resulting Like Likes lights a torch and spawns a treasure chest containing Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the cows to make Like Likes 
appear, so kill those to make a torch light up and a treasure chest to appear.
Open that for some Deku Sticks.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Destroying a high boulder in the wall reveals a Gold Skulltula that can be collected with the Boomerang while raised by a water jet.

evidence.quote:
look for a boulder up in the
wall. Use a Bombchu or well-timed bomb throw to destroy it to reveal a Gold
Skulltula and kill it in the process...step on the switch 
here to make a water jet appear on your feet. At its highest, use your 
Boomerang to get the Skulltula's token.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Shooting the other cow in the ulcer room makes a treasure chest containing Bombchus appear.

evidence.quote: Shoot the other cow here to make a treasure chest with Bombchus inside appear.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Following the lowered ledge above the Compass room leads to a chest containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Jump onto the 
ledge there and it will lower. Follow it, open the chest for a Recovery Heart, 
and enter the door.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Shooting the east cow in the room before the boss spawns a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
In this room, take down the Like Likes, and shoot the east cow to make a 
treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee to appear.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula on the center pillar in the room before the boss can be killed with Din's Fire and retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Now, climb this
pillar here in the center. Use Din's Fire to kill the Gold Skulltula, then L-
Target the token and use the Boomerang to catch it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Song of Time by the blue block in the Boomerang trench room makes it disappear, revealing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
- Blue block in trench room/Boomerang room. Play the Song of Time by the blue
 block to make it disappear, revealing a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the southwestern room with invisible enemies, a Gold Skulltula behind webbing across the water can be retrieved with the Boomerang after burning the web with Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
- In room where Princess Ruto used to be, take the southwestern door to end up
 in a room with invisible enemies...Afterwards, 
 a Hookshot structure will appear underwater. It's just used to get you to the
 other side, so do so, and use Din's Fire to burn the webbing. Boomerang the
 Gold Skulltula.

subject: Forest Temple
text: Hookshotting the Big Skulltula and stepping on the switch atop the vines in the first room reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
When up there, Hookshot the Big 
Skulltula and step on the switch to make a treasure chest appear. Open it for a
SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden in the shrubbery above and to the left of the locked door in the first hallway.

evidence.quote:
In this hall, Hookshot all the Big
Skulltulas, then head towards the locked door. Look up and to the left to see a
Gold Skulltula hidden in some shrubbery.

subject: Forest Temple
text: Defeating the Wolfos in the room past the Song of Time block spawns a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Kill the
Wolfos, and the door back will open, and a small chest containing a Small Key
will appear.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the corner of a small path to the left after defeating the Stalfos.

evidence.quote:
Battle the Stalfos and enter the next
room. Take a left and follow the little path to a corner with a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Forest Temple
text: Dropping down in the room with Wallmasters allows Link to open a colorful chest for the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Go through
the hall and Navi will warn about Wallmasters. Drop down and open the colorful
chest for the BOSS KEY.

subject: Forest Temple
text: Defeating the ReDead in the side room yields a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Turn right and open that door instead. Kill the ReDead to get a
Small Key.

subject: Forest Temple
text: Defeating all the Stalfos in the downstairs room rewards a treasure chest containing the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote:
Go downstairs and enter the door to enter a battle with some Stalfos. Kill them
all and open the treasure chest for the Fairy Bow.

subject: Forest Temple
text: Shooting the Poe inside the pictures and defeating her rewards a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
snipe the pictures with the Poe
inside them to make the Poe
escape. Fight her and open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Forest Temple
text: Revealing and defeating the second Poe rewards a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Reveal the next Poe and fight
her the same way as last time, and open the chest for the COMPASS.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Climbing the vines by the well in the grassy room leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In this grassy room, kill the
Octoroks, then find the well. Climb up the vines by it and kill the Gold 
Skulltula up there.
